name_reason: Compliant with fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. The trailing 20 is a legitimate chapter ID (chapters 01-30 are meaningful domain IDs), not an address residue (the function lives at 0x23E74). One of the fd2_chapter_NN_end series dispatched via data_fd2_chapter_end_handler_table[NN]. Name accurately reflects purpose.
purpose: Chapter 20 (死亡般的沈寂) end handler: post-battle cutscene transition that places the surviving cast at scripted positions, re-aims the camera, runs the dialog sequence, always recruits 謝多, conditionally recruits 達可賽 if won within 15 turns, then advances the chapter id.
logic_summary: Copies two scene position tables (scene1: 16-byte x/y for slots 0..15; scene2: 9-byte x/y for slots 0x34..0x3C) from private const arrays into stack scratch. Fades to black, clears all-acted flags, writes each scene1 char's pos_x/pos_y and sprite_state[1]=1, and each scene2 char's pos+sprite_state[1]=3. Resets battle_anim_phase, sets view-window origin (0x1A,0x1F), cursor_world (0x1A,0x1F), cursor_screen (0,0), composites one frame, fades in, delays 200ms. Shows dialog pages 0xB then 0xC (each followed by anim_phase reset / cutscene event 0x3B), recruits 謝多 (char 0x19) and saves the runtime char templates. If turn_counter < 16 (battle won within 15 turns): reloads portraits to FD2.TMP, runs cutscene events 0x3C/0x3D/0x3E interleaved with dialog pages 0xE/0xF/0x10, and recruits 達可賽 (char 0x1C). Finally shows dialog page 0xD and increments current_chapter_id.

returns.semantics: No return value; performs the chapter-20 end cutscene and advances current_chapter_id as a side effect.

comment_original_issue: src comment is accurate and concise (correctly states 'won within 15 turns (turn_counter < 16)'); kept. Ghidra plate had two stale items, fixed during refine: it labelled the conditional read as 'save_metadata < 16' (the global at 0x53BEF is actually data_fd2_battle_turn_counter), and it referenced the delay call as '__delay_thunk_375b2(200)' (function at 0x375B2 is now fd2_delay_ms).
notes: Indirect dispatch only (0 direct callers); xref from data table at 0x51E35, table entry index 20 holds little-endian pointer 743e0200 = 0x23E74. Verified char IDs against fd2-knowledge walkthrough: 0x19=謝多 (always joins), 0x1C=達可賽 (joins only if battle won within 15 turns) — matches '加入：忍者謝多。若在十五回合內結束則魔族達可塞加入'. Disasm confirms CMP [0x53BEF],0xf + JG = if (x < 0x10). Symbols verified: 0x53BEF=data_fd2_battle_turn_counter, 0x53A45=data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr, 0x375B2=fd2_delay_ms. No logic concerns.
